title: Spongy
body:
# Outdated

Requires Starcatcher _a mod about fishes_

_Ever wanted to fish out sponges in Minecraft? This data-pack makes it possible with [Starcatcher](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/starcatcher)'s Data-driven fishing!_

It adds:
- Fishable Wet Sponges from Oceans!
- Renewable Sponges
